data.name: Kabeera
data.gender_notes: Kabeera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kabara' meaning 'to be great, large, or grand'. This name is often given to girls who are expected to excel and leave a significant impact in the world. The name Kabeera carries the meaning “Great, Large, Grand” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kabeera usually hope their child will grow to embody great, large, grand and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a strong and powerful individual who is destined for greatness.
data.etymology: Kabeera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, Large, Grand.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kabeera total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
